observations: Figure 4: Comparison of threshold effect between the new method and DAC.
The figure shows a plot of 10 log(MSE) vs. 10 log(cσ_d), with four curves labeled: 'new method', 'DAC', 'CRLB', and 'BHB2'.
The x-axis ranges from -30 to -14; y-axis from 0 to 60.
The 'new method' curve lies below 'DAC' and above 'CRLB' for most of the range, approaching 'BHB2' at higher SNR (less negative x-values).
